summary: Noah Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the adoption of its Seventh Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association, effective June 11, 2026, along with poll results from the annual general meeting held that same day. The filing also announced payment of a final dividend and special dividend. No special-situation event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring — is disclosed. The amendment to governing documents and routine dividend declaration are ordinary corporate actions. As a non-U.S. filer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a U.S. 8-K for material events; here, only routine governance and dividend matters are reported. No advisory recommendation, deal terms, or shareholder action beyond the meeting results is noted.
